sources.snippet: This page documents the Vision-Language Pretraining topic category within the Awesome-Foundation-Models repository. It covers the eight papers listed under the ### Vision-Language Pretraining heading in README.md, explains the pretraining paradigms those papers represent, and shows how this category relates to the broader repository structure.

sources.title: [2202.10936] A Survey of Vision-Language Pre-Trained Models
sources.snippet: How to adapt pre-training to the field of Vision-and-Language (V-L) learning and improve downstream task performance becomes a focus of multimodal learning. In this paper, we review the recent progress in Vision-Language Pre-Trained Models (VL-PTMs).
